The [[Loag Dagger]] was a black blade which served as the emblem for the [[Loag]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] of [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]. The ancient dagger had passed through countless hands since its seizure by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] millennia before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. It was found to be missing from the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] circa [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].

It was 30 centimeters long, with a one-sided curved black blade. It had a dark hide hilt and used a red ruby as a pommel cap.
